input: Buy birthday presents for all nephews in advance

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many nephews there are and when their birthdays fall determines the scale of the task and whether any are urgent.
The ages and interests of each nephew directly shape what kinds of gifts are appropriate or off-limits.
A total or per-nephew budget sets hard limits on what can be bought and whether a tiered approach is needed.
Whether gifts need to be shipped to different locations or handed over in person affects logistics and lead time required.
Knowing whether to shop online, in-store, or both determines where to start and how to track purchases.
Whether all nephews should get equivalent gifts or personalised ones changes the research and effort involved for each.
Understanding how far in advance 'done' means — e.g. purchased, wrapped, and stored — defines when the task is truly complete.

gold.taskTitle: Buy birthday presents for all nephews in advance
gold.taskDescription: Plan and purchase birthday gifts for every nephew ahead of their birthdays, organised in advance to avoid last-minute stress.

questions.title: How many nephews, and when are their birthdays?
questions.description: Establish the number of nephews and the dates of their birthdays to understand the scope and any upcoming deadlines.

questions.title: What are each nephew's ages and main interests?
questions.description: Gather age and interest information for each nephew so gifts can be matched appropriately.

questions.title: What is your total or per-nephew gift budget?
questions.description: Clarify spending limits to filter options and decide whether all nephews receive the same value of gift.

questions.title: Do gifts need to be shipped, or given in person?
questions.description: Determine delivery method for each nephew, as distant relatives may require earlier purchasing and postage.

questions.title: Do you prefer shopping online, in-store, or both?
questions.description: Identify the preferred shopping channel to focus the search and streamline the purchasing process.

questions.title: Should gifts be personalised or broadly equivalent for all?
questions.description: Decide whether each nephew gets a tailored gift or whether a consistent, uniform approach is preferred.

questions.title: How far ahead counts as done — bought, wrapped, or stored?
questions.description: Define the finish line for this task, whether it means gifts are simply purchased or also wrapped and set aside ready to give.
